purpose: Map representative transformer GEMM roles to current OA shape/layout/launch contracts.

manifest_semantics.fallback: Use only the validated default where its contract applies; otherwise do not select native GEMM.
manifest_semantics.no_auto_dispatch: A syntactically accepted optional policy is not a measured winner for every role sharing its dimensions.
